context.question: Who will win the 2008 US presidential election?
context.setting: Sen. Barack Obama leads Sen. Hillary Clinton in the race for the Democratic nomination but has not clinched it; Sen. John McCain is the presumptive Republican nominee. The general election is on 4 November 2008. Saturn comes into opposition with Uranus beginning on Election Day, a configuration last seen 45 years earlier.

provenance.work: The Washington Times, news report, 20 May 2008
